env.description: Environment variables of the container, keyed by name. See [env](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/env).

resources.description: CPU, memory and extended resources the container requests and may use. See [resources](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/resources).

securityContext.description: Security context of the container. Overrides `securityContext.container` for this container. See [securityContext](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/securityContext).

imageSelector.description: Name of the image to use. It is a key on the root of the values that holds `repository`, `tag` and `pullPolicy`, eg `image`.

primary.description: Whether this is the primary container of the workload. Does **not** apply to `initContainers`.

stdin.description: Whether stdin stays open for the container (`stdin`).

tty.description: Whether a TTY is allocated for the container (`tty`).

probes.description: Liveness, readiness and startup probes of the container. Does **not** apply to `initContainers`. See [probes](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/probes).

command.description: Entrypoint of the container (`command`), which replaces the entrypoint of the image. A single command can be given as a string. See [command](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/command).

lifecycle.description: `postStart` and `preStop` hooks of the container. See [lifecycle](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/lifecycle).

envFrom.description: ConfigMaps and Secrets whose keys all become environment variables of the container. See [envFrom](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/envFrom).

termination.description: Where the termination message of the container is read from. See [termination](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/termination).

fixedEnv.description: Overrides of the environment variables that common sets on every container: `TZ`, `UMASK`, `PUID` and `NVIDIA_CAPS`. See [fixedEnv](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/fixedEnv).

args.description: Arguments of the container (`args`), which replace the `CMD` of the image. A single argument can be given as a string. See [args](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/args).

extraArgs.description: Arguments that are appended **after** `args`, as a string or a list.

additionalProperties.description: A container of the pod. The shared container settings are in [container](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers).

containers.description: Containers of the pod, keyed by name.

initContainers.description: Init containers of the pod, keyed by name. See [initContainers](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/initContainers).

labels.description: Additional labels for the pods of this workload.

annotations.description: Additional annotations for the pods of this workload.

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Whether the service account token is mounted into the pods (`automountServiceAccountToken`). Overrides `podOptions.automountServiceAccountToken` for this workload.

hostNetwork.description: Whether the pods use the network namespace of the node (`hostNetwork`). `dnsPolicy` is set to `ClusterFirstWithHostNet` automatically when this is `true`. Overrides `podOptions.hostNetwork` for this workload.

hostPID.description: Whether the containers can see the processes of the node (`hostPID`). Overrides `podOptions.hostPID` for this workload.

hostIPC.description: Whether the containers share the IPC namespace of the node (`hostIPC`). Overrides `podOptions.hostIPC` for this workload.

hostUsers.description: Whether the pods use the user namespace of the node (`hostUsers`). When `false`, the pod gets its own user namespace. When not set, common calculates it. Overrides `podOptions.hostUsers` for this workload.

shareProcessNamespace.description: Whether all containers of a pod share one process namespace (`shareProcessNamespace`), so they can see and signal each other's processes. Overrides `podOptions.shareProcessNamespace` for this workload.

enableServiceLinks.description: Whether Kubernetes injects environment variables for the Services of the namespace into the containers (`enableServiceLinks`). Overrides `podOptions.enableServiceLinks` for this workload.

restartPolicy.description: Restart policy of the pods (`restartPolicy`): `Always`, `OnFailure` or `Never`. Deployments, StatefulSets and DaemonSets only allow `Always`. Jobs and CronJobs default to `OnFailure` and do not allow `Always`. Overrides `podOptions.restartPolicy` for this workload.

schedulerName.description: Name of the scheduler that schedules the pods (`schedulerName`). The default scheduler is used when empty. Overrides `podOptions.schedulerName` for this workload.

priorityClassName.description: Name of the PriorityClass of the pods (`priorityClassName`), which sets their scheduling priority. Overrides `podOptions.priorityClassName` for this workload.

hostname.description: Hostname of the pods (`hostname`). It must be a valid DNS label.

affinity.description: Affinity rules of the pods, passed on as is. Overrides `podOptions.affinity` for this workload.

additionalProperties.description: A setting passed on as is.

serviceAccountName.description: Name of the service account the pods use (`serviceAccountName`). When not set, common uses the service account that targets this workload, or `default`. Supports Helm `tpl`.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds Kubernetes waits for the containers to stop after they receive SIGTERM, before it kills them (`terminationGracePeriodSeconds`). Overrides `podOptions.terminationGracePeriodSeconds` for this workload.

nodeSelector.description: Labels a node must have for the pods to be scheduled on it (`nodeSelector`). Overrides `podOptions.nodeSelector` for this workload.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Rules that spread the pods across topology domains such as nodes or zones (`topologySpreadConstraints`). Overrides `podOptions.topologySpreadConstraints` for this workload.

hostAliases.description: Extra entries for the `/etc/hosts` file of the pods (`hostAliases`). Overrides `podOptions.hostAliases` for this workload.

dnsPolicy.description: DNS policy of the pods (`dnsPolicy`): `ClusterFirst`, `ClusterFirstWithHostNet`, `Default` or `None`. It is forced to `ClusterFirstWithHostNet` when `hostNetwork` is `true`. Overrides `podOptions.dnsPolicy` for this workload.

nameservers.description: IP addresses of extra DNS servers, at most 3. Added to the servers of `dnsPolicy`.

searches.description: Extra DNS search domains, at most 6. Added to the search domains of `dnsPolicy`.

options.description: Resolver options of the pods, eg `ndots`.

name.description: Name of the resolver option, eg `ndots`.

items.description: A resolver option, with a name and an optional value.

dnsConfig.description: Extra DNS settings of the pods (`dnsConfig`). Overrides `podOptions.dnsConfig` for this workload.

tolerations.description: Taints the pods tolerate (`tolerations`). Overrides `podOptions.tolerations` for this workload.

operator.description: How the taint is matched: `Exists` matches any value of the key, `Equal` requires `value` to be equal.

key.description: Key of the taint. Required when `operator` is `Equal`.

value.description: Value of the taint. Required when `operator` is `Equal`, and must be empty when it is `Exists`.

effect.description: Effect of the taint to tolerate: `NoSchedule`, `PreferNoSchedule` or `NoExecute`. All effects match when empty.

tolerationSeconds.description: Seconds the pod stays bound to a node with a `NoExecute` taint before it is evicted. Only applies to the `NoExecute` effect.

items.description: A toleration of a node taint.

runtimeClassName.description: Name of the RuntimeClass of the pods (`runtimeClassName`), to run them with another container runtime. Overrides `podOptions.runtimeClassName` for this workload.

podSpec.description: Settings of the pods of the workload: containers, init containers and pod level options.

revisionHistoryLimit.description: Number of old ReplicaSets, ControllerRevisions or history entries that are kept for rollbacks (`revisionHistoryLimit`).

allowRollingUpdateWithRWO.description:
Keep `strategy: RollingUpdate` on a single replica Deployment with `ReadWriteOnce` volumes, instead of changing it to `Recreate`. Overrules `global.fallbackDefaults.allowRollingUpdateWithRWO`. `ReadWriteOncePod` volumes always use `Recreate`.

:::caution

Rolling updates with `ReadWriteOnce` storage are not safe for every app or storage:

- An update gets stuck if the storage stays locked to the old pod. This can happen on the same node with storage like iSCSI, and on another node with any `ReadWriteOnce` storage.
- Two pods use the same data during an update, which can damage data of apps that expect to be alone, for example with SQLite or database migrations.

Common shows a warning in the notes when this is enabled.

:::

strategy.description:
Update strategy of the workload. Deployments accept `Recreate` and `RollingUpdate`, StatefulSets and DaemonSets accept `RollingUpdate` and `OnDelete`. Set `maxUnavailable`, `maxSurge` and `partition` under `rollingUpdate`.

A single replica Deployment uses `Recreate` if it mounts a `ReadWriteOnce` or `ReadWriteOncePod` volume. Set `allowRollingUpdateWithRWO` to keep `RollingUpdate` with `ReadWriteOnce`.

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum number of pods that can be unavailable during an update, as a number or a percentage like `25%`. Only used when `strategy` is `RollingUpdate`.

partition.description: Pods with an ordinal lower than this number are not updated (`partition`). Only used when `strategy` is `RollingUpdate`.

maxSurge.description: Maximum number of pods that can be created above the desired number during an update, as a number or a percentage like `25%`. Only used when `strategy` is `RollingUpdate`.

rollingUpdate.description: Settings of the `RollingUpdate` strategy. Only used when `strategy` is `RollingUpdate`.

initContainers.description: Not used. Init containers go under `podSpec.initContainers`.

completionMode.description: Completion mode of a Job: `NonIndexed` or `Indexed` (`completionMode`).

backoffLimit.description: Number of retries before a Job is marked as failed (`backoffLimit`).

completions.description: Number of pods that must finish successfully for a Job to complete (`completions`).

parallelism.description: Maximum number of pods of a Job that run at the same time (`parallelism`).

ttlSecondsAfterFinished.description: Seconds after which a finished Job is deleted automatically (`ttlSecondsAfterFinished`).

activeDeadlineSeconds.description: Maximum number of seconds a Job can run before it is stopped (`activeDeadlineSeconds`).

schedule.description: Cron schedule of a CronJob, in the standard 5 field format (`schedule`).

suspend.description: Whether the CronJob is suspended, so no new Jobs start (`suspend`). Forced to `true` when `stopAll` is enabled.

timezone.description: Time zone of the schedule of a CronJob (`timeZone`), eg `Europe/Amsterdam`. Defaults to the `TZ` value.

concurrencyPolicy.description: What a CronJob does when the previous run is still running: `Allow` both, `Forbid` the new run or `Replace` the old one (`concurrencyPolicy`).

failedJobsHistoryLimit.description: Number of failed Jobs of a CronJob that are kept (`failedJobsHistoryLimit`).

successfulJobsHistoryLimit.description: Number of successful Jobs of a CronJob that are kept (`successfulJobsHistoryLimit`).

startingDeadlineSeconds.description: Seconds after the scheduled time in which a CronJob can still start a missed run (`startingDeadlineSeconds`).

primary.description: Whether this is the primary workload of the chart. A chart needs one primary workload.

extraSelectorLabels.description: Additional labels that are added to the selector of the workload and to the labels of its pods.

annotationsList.description: Additional annotations as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the annotations of the workload.

labelsList.description: Additional labels as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the labels of the workload.

labels.description: Additional labels for the workload object.

annotations.description: Additional annotations for the workload object.

namespace.description: Namespace of the workload. Defaults to the namespace of the release.

serviceAccountName.description: Not used. Set the service account of the pods with `podSpec.serviceAccountName`, or with the top-level `serviceAccount` key and its `targetSelector`.

dbWait.description: Whether init containers that wait for the enabled dependencies (mariadb, postgresql, mongodb, clickhouse, valkey) are added to the workload. The workloads of [dependencies](/truecharts-common/dependencies) default to `false`, so they do not wait for themselves.

additionalProperties.description: A workload, spawned as a Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, Job or CronJob.

description: Workloads of the chart, keyed by name.
